title: Bio-Telemetry Spatial Visualizer
subtitle: Next-generation spatial rendering engine for migratory animal tracking data
description: Next-generation spatial rendering engine for migratory animal tracking data, engineered for ecological metadata management and reactive spatial filtering using advanced GIS layers.
longDescription: The Bio-Telemetry Spatial Visualizer is built as an enterprise-grade Angular 22 single-page application. It completely bypasses Zone.js in favor of experimental zoneless change detection to maximize frame-rate performance for high-frequency Leaflet GIS canvas rendering and real-time telemetry streaming.

architecture.title: Zoneless GIS & Rendering Pipeline
architecture.description: High-throughput rendering architecture optimized for dense geographic telemetry streams.
steps: Experimental zoneless execution eliminating Zone.js overhead for maximum frame rates
Fine-grained state synchronization using Angular Signals and toSignal() bridges
Strict modular standalone architecture with lazy-loaded deferrable views (@defer)
Decoupled Leaflet GIS integration managed via enterprise services with DestroyRef cleanup

scientificImpact: Enables real-time rendering of complex high-frequency migratory animal tracking paths
Eliminates UI jank during heavy spatial filtering and geographic zooming operations
Provides a robust blueprint for modern open science ecological visualization tools
keyFeatures: High-performance vector and marker layer rendering using optimized Leaflet.js integrations
Signal-powered reactive filtering for instant updates across species, tags, and date ranges
Spatial bounding box selection tools to isolate specific geographic study areas and subsets
Multi-layered environmental overlay support combining tracking paths with terrain and climate data
Interactive popup inspection for detailed individual telemetry logs and timestamp records
Export capabilities for filtered geospatial subsets in standard formats like GeoJSON and CSV
